learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and understanding: Knowledge and understanding of mathematics and other basic sciences inherent to their engineering specialization, at a level that allows acquiring the rest of the degree's competencies.
Knowledge and understanding: Be aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.

Engineering analysis: The ability to analyze complex products, processes, and systems in their field of study; choose and apply relevant established analytical, computational, and experimental methods and correctly interpret the results of such analyses.

Engineering projects: Ability to plan, design, and develop complex products (parts, components, finished products, etc.), processes, and systems of their specialty, that comply with established requirements, including awareness of social, health and safety, environmental, economic, and industrial aspects; as well as selecting and applying appropriate project methods.
Practical application of engineering: Knowledge of the social, health and safety, environmental, economic, and industrial implications of engineering practice.

Practical application of engineering: General ideas about economic, organizational, and management issues (such as project management, risk, and change management) in the industrial and business context.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems, and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to function effectively in national and international contexts, individually and in teams, and to cooperate with engineers and people from other disciplines.
Calculates and analyzes the costs of a product or service and studies the economic-financial viability of an investment project.

syllabus_topics: Basic knowledge about the company: the company as a system, functions, and elements.
The company's environment and its social responsibility: general and specific environment.
Types of companies: by size, economic activity, legal and juridical form, according to capital.
Analyzing the economic and financial structure and situation of the company.
teaching_methods: Development, drafting and presentation of reports, memos, audiovisual material, etc. related to projects/POPBLs, carried out individually or in teams
Individual study and work, tests, exams, and control points
Completion of individual and team exercises
Problem solving and project practices in real and/or simulated contexts

assessment_methods.method: Written and oral individual tests for the evaluation of technical competencies of the subject
Reports on the completion of exercises, case studies, computer practices, simulation practices, and laboratory practices
Technical capacity, involvement in the project/PBL, work performed, results obtained, documentation submitted, presentation and technical defense

assessment_rules: Evaluation of exercises, case studies, computer practices, simulation practices, laboratory practices, and the semester project is continuous. Resit mechanisms for individual written and oral tests are also individual written and oral tests. Resit mechanisms for technical capacity, project involvement, work performed, results, documentation, presentation, and technical defense are the same activity.
